title: Claude vs ChatGPT which to get?
author: Lelouda
selftext:
hello, I’ve used Claude code extensively at work for coding project and wanted to try and create a game. will most likely be a 2d pixel art just for fun maybe something me and my friends can play. will try to use mostly ready assests that exist online and wish to pick and ai for the coding.  

looking mostly at getting the 20$ dollar plan and looking at either ChatGPT or Claude. will use codex or Claude code. What is generally recommended? I feel like not getting fable on the 20$ dollar plan is pretty backbreaking.. never tried Astra but I’ve heard good things regarding it? 

thanks!

comments.author: Every-Prize4720
comments.body: get the better one?

comments.author: XalAtoh
comments.body:
I have 200 euro plan Claude, and 200 euro plan Gpt6.

They both are good, you can build incredible software with both of them..

replies.author: ImportGuy
replies.body: I realized like 2 days too late that I wanted the 200 gpt plan. Hopefully they re-open sign ups soon

replies.author: BrownaroStudios
replies.body: Not everyone can have the 200 GPT plan?  Is that a real thing?  We have been using CC and have been considering switching with the new usage restrictions that went live on the 14th of September but if we can't get the 200 GPT plan there is almost no reason to do that for us.

replies.author: PrettyBaker2891
replies.body:
yup its real, they removed it for new subscribers. you can only get the 100$ 5x plan

they are running out of compute. thats also why usage limits have been absolutely dogshit lately and why astra felt way dumber for the past week

comments.author: Intelligent_Art_7565
comments.body: Depends i feel claude is better at coding and gpt at code review. As for design and high level stuff i think gpt is more polished.

comments.author: BoltVnderhuge
comments.body:
I used pixellab.ai for art and Claude code for implementation in godot. With the MCPs, you can do almost every thing just through Claude. For $20, you can make progress but will hit your limits quickly if you put in a consistent effort. 

If you have good success with Claude and know how to navigate the models, I would stick with that. GPT was quite a bit better for a while but recently seem to have nerfed things.

comments.author: egonosz
comments.body:
“Now this is a load bearing question.”  If you want to work with it as engineer and look into code I would prefer codex. If you want to go full vibe: I would say Claude is generating less tech dept and it is better with larger code base, but it feels like even opus is burning more tokens then sol.

But if you work with Claude at job maybe it sort to try Codex.

replies.author: aejt
replies.body: I feel the complete opposite. Claude goes into more technical details in both plans and summaries, whereas GPT is more hand-wavey.

replies.author: egonosz
replies.body:
Yes, Claude over complicates the things in planning phase, however it will implement mostly what you want. Codex sometimes implement things because you asked it on planning phase and it wasn’t even in the plan. The codex implementations I seen were way more scarier than the Claude ones. Claude is just extremely trash in naming. You can hand wave codex and Claude too, but I think Claude will hit the insane amount of tech debt later.

This is an opinion based on my experience, but I using these agents to write a pretty new type of game engine and I read all the code and tell them exactly what they need to implement. I prefer to use codex, because it is cheaper do not ask tons of questions, but I do it in this way because I read the code and I plan the architecture. If I would vibe code I would pick Claude.

comments.author: akanas
comments.body: Coding - Claude, everything else chatgepete

comments.author: Cubey42
comments.body: ![gif](giphy|3ohfFhG5VDtDTzQv2o)

comments.author: Megamozg
comments.body: Get self education better

comments.author: Eshinio
comments.body: I have the Pro (~$20) plans for both GPT and Claude. I use GPT Astra as the planner and brainstormer, as well as handling various questions about the project. I cant really use Astra for actual work, since usage is spent after 10 minutes. I use Claude for all the actual programming/coding/texturing/modeling work, and Sonnet 5 has been amazing so far, get a lot done per usage limit.

replies.author: MasterQuiet2301
replies.body: Hey, I'm thinking about getting either GPT or Claude, which one gives you the most usage for programming tasks?

replies.author: Eshinio
replies.body: Then I would go with Claude for sure. Sonnet 5 can be your planner/brainstormer and then an Opus model or Fable for the programming work. But I have great success using Sonnet 5 as programmer as well.

comments.author: Adventurous_Win_8692
comments.body:
Go with GPT. Heres why.
1. GPT has more generous usage over claude.
2. GPT 5.6 sol is already really good so astra/fable are unusable on a $20 plan so you'll likely not be using the top tier
3. GPT specifically for gamedev gives you image and video generation where as with claude you'll need another service to fill that role.

If you're doing the majority of art yourself than maybe claude, its code is maybe slightly better but not by much, value per dollar GPT i put ahead

comments.author: cumbiaowl
comments.body:
Get both. 

Give them the same task, observe outputs, learn. Rinse/repeat until you’re confident that a certain model can do the best work at the lowest cost.

comments.author: glimsky
comments.body: Claude is slightly better but ChatGPT has a better cost-benefit. I ended up settling with ChatGPT.

comments.author: Eldrisch
comments.body: Codex, more for less, quality also similar. Im not really a fan of opus 5, sol also talks a little bit too much but its better at listening to steering/skills.

comments.author: gago8D
comments.body: I’m a novice at developing ai games but what I can tell you is that I use both.  I use chat got for asset designs and Claude for the actual coding of the game.  I haven’t really tried to code a game with chat gpt but I am sure it’s just as good.  The thing with Claude is that it adds things you don’t ask for at times sometimes it’s good other times it’s bad 😂.

comments.body:
Ahort answer for me Claude.
Long answer .for both i use 20 D plan.for some reason i felt like i have better usage with claude ,if you got with gpt be warn that astra model is really token consuming, for my task actually opus or Sol are doing greats choose gpt if you want imagen

comments.body: My work flow is Codex to implement and Claude to audit (the work sometimes crosses over) and Chatgpt web to review the markdown reports and generate new markdown tasks to send in.
